data.source: authenticated Alpaca CLI 0.0.14 historical stock bars

limitations: IEX is not consolidated SIP and historical OHLC has no intrabar ordering.
The 2025-2026 window is rolling pseudo-OOS, not a never-observed external future.
Direct ETF-share fills do not model short-locate availability or market impact.
A large neighboring grid raises multiple-testing risk; fold selection is past-only but cannot erase that risk.

method.costs: 1 bp adverse slippage plus $0.005/share/side; stress is 1.5x
method.entry: next daily regular-session open after a completed signal day
method.execution: split-adjusted Alpaca IEX OHLC; stop-first; one serialized position
method.selection: monthly expanding walk-forward; variant selected on completed prior trades only
